app.title: Plugin Shell
app.intro: A working foundation, not another blank canvas. Explore the services behind this view, then make them your own.
app.scope: This is a working first slice. Full makers, automatic releases and device qualification are still planned.

overview.title: Everything is connected.
overview.subtitle: Real components. Real services. Your Obsidian theme.
overview.safe: Nothing is written to your vault until you review and confirm.

cards.documentsText: Validate a Task, preview its frontmatter, then create one complete note.
cards.eventsText: Watch committed facts flow between services without a global singleton.
cards.feedbackText: Field errors stay with the form. Native notices remain deliberate.
cards.themeText: Scoped component styles follow the host’s colors, type and spacing.

overview.flowText: The same services run inside Obsidian and in the browser harness. Only the host adapters change.

doc.title: Create a Task document
doc.subtitle: The Markdown file is the record. There is no duplicate Task database.
doc.label: Title
doc.empty: Your Markdown preview will appear here.
doc.emptyText: Enter a title and preview the exact content and destination.
doc.note: Existing notes are never overwritten. Preview does not create files or folders.
doc.browserNote: Harness mode: notes are stored in this browser’s synthetic vault, not a real Obsidian vault.

events.title: See the wiring work
events.subtitle: Events carry facts. Commands perform actions. Every subscription has an owner.
events.empty: No events yet. Publish one or create a document.
events.safety: Payloads are not included in diagnostic logs. Closing a view removes its listeners.
events.expected: This is a deliberate feedback example. Your data has not changed.

settings.title: Make it feel at home
settings.subtitle: The same preferences are available in Obsidian’s native plugin settings.
settings.languageHelp: Updates the view immediately. Registered command labels update after a plugin reload.
settings.folderHelp: A vault-relative folder, for example Tasks or Projects/Tasks.
settings.noticesHelp: Also show a native notice after successful document creation.
settings.themeHelp: No independent color mode is installed. Components consume the host’s CSS variables.
settings.blocked: Stored settings could not be safely read. Defaults are shown for inspection only; saving is disabled to preserve the original data.

feedback.native: This notice came through the host adapter.

modal.title: One view, two environments
modal.text: This dialog uses the Obsidian Modal API in the plugin and an isolated browser adapter in the harness. The application services do not depend on either implementation.

error.title: Enter a title with 1–120 characters.
error.tags: Use up to 12 short tags with letters, numbers, hyphens or slashes.
error.folder: Use a safe relative folder without hidden names, traversal or special filename characters.
error.settingsRead: Stored settings are protected. Resolve the read error before saving.
error.settingsWrite: Preferences were not saved. Your previous values remain active.
error.conflict: The destination already exists. No file was overwritten.
error.write: The note was not created. Check the destination and permissions.
error.uncertain: The write result is uncertain. Check the exact destination before trying a new submission.
error.open: The note is created, but could not be opened. Retry opening; do not create it again.
error.stale: This preview no longer matches the request or destination. Prepare a new preview.
error.disposed: This view has closed. Reopen the showcase.
error.request: Invalid submission identity. Prepare a new preview.
error.entity: The entity definition is invalid or unavailable.
error.sessionLimit: This session reached its 100-preview limit. Reopen the plugin before preparing more.
error.unexpected: An unexpected error was contained. Check the diagnostic panel.
error.render: This view encountered a rendering error. Close and reopen the view. Your documents are unchanged.
